Activities: FIRST LEGO League; church youth band (bass)
Q: What do you do when nobody is making: I take apart old radios from the thrift store and try to get at least one working again. I have a shelf of the ones that almost worked.
Q: Tell us about a time something was ha: Our robot fell apart at regionals and I was the one who had to tell the team. I rebuilt the arm that night with zip ties and we came in fourth.
Q: Who do you want to become?: Someone who fixes things that other people already gave up on — machines at first, maybe people later.

Q: What do you do when nobody is making: I read about wars. Not the battles, the part right before, when people could still have chosen something else.
Q: Tell us about a time something was ha: I got cut from the travel team in seventh grade. I kept going to practice anyway to help with drills and made it back the next year.
Q: Who do you want to become?: A person who can walk into a room where everybody is angry and make them actually listen to each other.

Q: What do you do when nobody is making: I paint the dogs at the shelter so their adoption photos look less sad. Three of them got adopted after.
Q: Tell us about a time something was ha: My grandpa died last spring and I stopped painting for a while. My art teacher asked me to paint him and I did.
Q: Who do you want to become?: Someone whose art makes people notice who is being overlooked.

Q: What do you do when nobody is making: I make small games for my little brother and change the rules when he starts losing.
Q: Tell us about a time something was ha: Moving schools in sixth grade. I didn't know anyone and ate lunch in the library for two months.
Q: Who do you want to become?: Someone who builds things that make people feel less alone.

Q: What do you do when nobody is making: I practice cello scales in the dark because it makes me listen instead of look.
Q: Tell us about a time something was ha: I have dyslexia and reading out loud in class used to be the worst part of my day.
Q: Who do you want to become?: A doctor who actually has time to listen.
